open_points.subject: create_budget_schema
open_points.text: - create_budget_schema: [CONFIG_REFERENCE] MUST idempotently create only the tables named by = config.persistence.budget_version_table_name and = config.persistence.section_plan_table_name with columns corresponding one-to-one to BudgetVersion and SectionPlan fields; version_id and plan_id are primary keys, (version_id, section_id) is unique, and nullable model fields remain nullable.
open_points.other_text: Use only the IMPORTS listed above plus required standard library imports.
open_points.question: Must config be added to IMPORTS, or must the table names be supplied through an available import or argument?
